turnaround_reason: Charter has collapsed ~47% from its 52-week high on accelerating broadband subscriber losses (172K lost in Q2 2026 vs 116K a year prior) as fixed-wireless (T-Mobile/Verizon) and fiber overbuilders erode its cable moat. It now trades at a distressed ~3.9x trailing / ~3.5x forward earnings and ~5.5x EV/EBITDA, and the market is treating it as a melting ice cube. The bull case is that the network is far from melting: it still throws off ~$16.5B operating cash flow, mobile is compounding (12.5M lines, +15.5% YoY), and the $34.5B Cox acquisition closing this month adds scale and $800M-$1B of run-rate synergies.
bullish_points: Deep value: ~3.9x TTM / ~3.5x fwd P/E and ~5.5x EV/EBITDA on a business generating ~$54B revenue and $16.5B operating cash flow
Heavy insider conviction: net ~1.58M shares purchased by insiders over 6 months, including CEO Chris Winfrey buying ~6,900 shares at $172 (well above the current $152)
Cox merger ($34.5B) closing mid-to-late August 2026 — adds scale, an $11.4B network-modernization capex plan, and $800M-$1B of run-rate synergies Winfrey calls conservative
Spectrum Mobile is the growth engine: 12.5M lines, +15.5% YoY, converged bundle improves churn economics
Extreme short interest (~50% of float, 7.2 short ratio) sets up potential squeeze on any subscriber-trend stabilization
bearish_points: Secular broadband erosion is accelerating, not stabilizing — Q2 net losses widened YoY; CEO admitted the retention strategy was 'too aggressive'
Enormous leverage: ~$96.7B total debt, EV ~$119.5B, debt/equity ~441, current ratio 0.36 — refinancing/rate risk amplifies equity moves
Revenue already shrinking (-1.7% TTM); the value multiple is cheap precisely because terminal-decline risk is real
Merger integration + $11.4B capex plan pressures near-term free cash flow just as the core is under attack

catalyst: Close of the $34.5B Cox Communications acquisition and the market's read on whether Q3/Q4 broadband net-adds stabilize as converged mobile bundling scales
catalyst_timing: Cox close mid-to-late August 2026; next earnings 2026-10-30
suggested_trade: Small spot starter only, sized as a levered battleground. Wait for confirmation of a broadband net-add inflection before adding; a longer-dated call spread is defensible for those wanting convex exposure into the Cox close but is not required.
key_risk: Broadband losses keep accelerating post-Cox, turning a cheap-multiple value name into a leveraged value trap where the equity gets squeezed between debt service and declining EBITDA.
would_skip_if: You want a clean secular-growth story or can't stomach 400%+ debt/equity; the accelerating (not stabilizing) sub losses mean this only works if the Cox-driven convergence bundle bends the churn curve.
